text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic complete hollow outfit, no person, skin or visible mannequin, pure white seamless background, soft studio light, portrait 2:3, fully uncropped. Garments: Charcoal textured band collar long sleeve shirt over black inner top with black turned cuffs, black wide-leg trousers, black shoes.. Add ONLY these accessories: A silver trouser key chain with hook, short linked chain, key-shaped metal charms and a narrow brown leather tassel, shown detached as one accessory.; A pair of black leather gloves, both complete, arranged side by side.; A large black woven leather tote handbag with two short handles.. Use each accessory once. Neckties are tied with one knot and the narrow tail hidden; for sweater layers tuck the long tail under the sweater. No additional accessories or props.
original_prompt: Edit this exact product photo to remove unwanted additions. Remove the neck chain or tassel completely. Keep ONE trouser chain attached at the hip. Remove any belt. Preserve gray band collar shirt, black trousers, shoes, black woven bag and pair of black gloves. Preserve all other cuts, colors, proportions and fabric detail. Empty hollow clothes, no skin or mannequin, white seamless background, full outfit uncropped. Do not add anything.
